judge.rationale: The candidate never actually edited `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, so the core bug remains unfixed and the new acceptance test will fail. Additionally, the candidate completely missed the acceptance criterion requiring an update to `CHANGELOG.md`. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate updated the bullet in place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (leaving contradictory prose claiming two properties when three bullets follow) instead of moving the new guarantee into the main specification list as the reference did. Finally, the candidate created a new standalone test file and left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree rather than adding the test case to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
